statements.impact_statement: Applies only to the zlib APK in linux/amd64 manifest sha256:a4328c48117c7f82167ae3a247250bbd5853fde574dfe30b3f62aa3ebfe75832, selected by RabbitMQ 4.4.0-alpine index sha256:7b77c3d3a996c7fcca1ca8bf53ce1557ff43c13b8ca2c132df6031781b209ef2. CVE-2026-4738 affects contrib/infback9/inftree9.c. Alpine source commit 0afa2da0e8c8051c6f8f64a7a388e5a259904245 builds standard shared libz without that contrib code. Installed APK files contain only libz.so.1 and libz.so.1.3.2. Extracted libz SHA-256 ecc8b9dfc45eb7fa29b410ffaca6257873890de53b80fe91735737b49067c5f2 matches the APK file checksum; its exported symbols contain inflateBack but no inflateBack9 family or inflate_table9. Package version remains 1.3.2-r1; no package update or custom image was applied. See rabbitmq-zlib-evidence.json and rabbitmq-zlib-symbols.txt for retained evidence.
